epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero placeholder submissions and 100% authentic CRIE domain entity rendering
epics.tocConstraintRef: Presentation layer endpoint wiring and domain fidelity
requirements: R1: Replace synthetic FinTech archetype and placeholders in approved design mockup with authentic FBUN CRIE educational entities (ordinators, aspirators, departments, normative documents)
R2: Bind mockup interactive form controls and search queries directly to live backend endpoints (/api/search and /api/documents/facets) instead of placeholder '#' actions

slices.title: Remediate approved mockup domain identity and wire live CRIE search endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing domain fidelity fixes for this epic, I want to replace FinTech stubs with FBUN CRIE catalog entities and wire forms to /api/search and /api/documents/facets, so that the knowledge base presentation layer reflects authentic institutional workflows without disconnected placeholders.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup file at design/approved/20261110024515-mockup/mockup.html
When inspecting header branding, labels, select options, and statistics
Then FinTech placeholders ('FIN_TECH', 'operator@domain.com', '16 Slots') are replaced with FBUN CRIE academic entities, residency departments, and normative document counts
Given search and filtering form controls in mockup.html
When a user inputs a query or selects a specialty/category facet
Then the form dispatches requests to /api/search and /api/documents/facets rather than submitting to placeholder '#' action.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Approved design mockup presentation fidelity and live API binding
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 invalid placeholder attributes in mockup form elements
